summary.text: Kyle Mullins is the Democratic incumbent, in office since December 1, 2018, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 112, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kyle Mullins assumed office on December 1, 2018.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignment as the Capitol Preservation Committee.
In 2023-2024 he was vice chair of the Appropriations Committee and subcommittee chair on Transportation Safety of the Transportation Committee.
